name: @murmur/desktop
author: Jordan Bremer <jordanbremer98@gmail.com>
description: Murmur desktop shell — Electron main process, preload bridge and the Hub / Bar / audio-capture renderers.

scripts.pack:mac: npm run sidecars:dir && bash ../../scripts/sidecars/build-audio-tap.sh && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.pack:win: npm run sidecars:dir && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.pack:linux: npm run sidecars:dir && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.release:mac: npm run sidecars:dir && bash ../../scripts/sidecars/build-audio-tap.sh && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.release:win: npm run sidecars:dir && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
scripts.release:linux: npm run sidecars:dir && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --config electron-builder.yml --publish always
